rules.statement: Orders for delivery of possession under Section 287 of the Civil Procedure Code should be treated as decrees for the purposes of sections 323 to 330, which govern execution of such orders.
rules.supporting_quote: "In view of the provision in section 287 that an order for delivery of possession may be enforced as an order falling under section 217 (C) (the purchaser being considered as judgment-creditor), of the use of the words 'or order' in section 328 and of their subsequent omission, which must have been per incuriam, it appears to me that the Legislature intended to put orders under section 287 on the footing of decrees for the purposes of the group of sections with which we are here concerned"
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 328 of the Civil Procedure Code
